text.p: The Weather Service Office of Mauritius issued a cyclone alert on Monday morning as moderate depression Gretelle loomed in the neighbourhood of the tropical Indian Ocean island.
The Office said Gretelle was centred at 330 km (205 miles) north east of Mauritius and was moving in a south-west direction at 12 km (seven miles) per hour.
On this trajectory, Gretelle will be at its closest point to Mauritius on Wednesday, 250 km (155 miles) west of the island, the Weather Office said.
But it did not exclude the possibility of a change in direction of Gretelle which would bring its centre closer to Mauritius and inflict cyclone conditions on the sugar-growing island.
